title: 押运途中封签异常与银行付款截止
english: A seal discrepancy and a payment deadline

modules.title: 发音热身
lines: Seal integrity
封签完整性
Escort officer
押运人员
Discrepancy
差异
Cut-off time
截止时间
Chain of custody
货物或样品的交接链
modules.hint: 逐词慢读三遍，再用正常语速复述。注意 integrity 和 discrepancy 的重音。

modules.title: 高频词与短语
lines: Seal number
封签号
Weighbridge ticket
地磅单
Escort log
押运日志
Tamper evidence
篡改痕迹
Payment hold
暂停付款
Supporting documents
支持文件
Beneficiary account
收款账户
Discrepancy report
差异报告
Release authorization
放行授权
Escalation path
升级处理路径
modules.hint: 先听慢速，再用正常语速读出英文并说出中文含义。

modules.title: 核心句
lines: Please stop the truck at the designated checkpoint.
请在指定检查点停车。
The seal number does not match the dispatch record.
封签号与发运记录不符。
Do not break the seal without written authorization.
未获书面授权不得拆封。
Please photograph all four sides of the container.
请拍摄集装箱四面。
We need the original weighbridge ticket.
我们需要原始地磅单。
The bank has placed the payment on hold.
银行已暂停该笔付款。
Can you confirm the beneficiary details in writing?
能否书面确认收款人信息？
Our deadline is three p.m. Kigali time.
截止时间为基加利时间下午三点。
We will escalate this discrepancy to compliance.
我们将把差异提交合规部门。
Release is subject to document verification.
放行以单证核验通过为前提。
modules.hint: 练习时按停车、取证、暂停付款和书面放行的顺序复述。

modules.title: 数字、金额、吨位、品位与汇率
lines: The shipment weighs eighteen thousand four hundred and fifty kilograms, or eighteen point four five metric tonnes.
The tin grade is sixty-two point five percent.
锡品位为 62.5%。
The quoted price is nineteen thousand eight hundred US dollars per tonne.
报价为每吨 19,800 美元。
One US dollar equals one thousand four hundred and seventy-five Rwandan francs in this exercise.
本题假设 1 美元兑换 1,475 卢旺达法郎。
The payment amount is thirty-six thousand five hundred and thirty-one US dollars.
模拟付款金额为 36,531 美元。
The dispatch record shows R W, zero four eight two one nine.
发运记录中的模拟封签号为 RW-048219。
The seal on the container reads R W, zero four eight two nine one.
集装箱上的模拟封签号为 RW-048291。
The last three digits do not match.
最后三位数字不一致。
modules.hint: 以下数字均为教学假设。请口述重量、品位、报价、汇率和付款金额，然后对照两组虚构封签号。

modules.title: 逐句跟读
lines: We have identified a seal-number discrepancy during the escorted transfer.
我们在押运途中发现封签号不一致。
The truck is secure, and the driver has been instructed not to move.
车辆已安全停靠，司机已接到原地等待的指令。
We are checking the weighbridge ticket, escort log, and dispatch photos before authorizing release.
我们正在核对地磅单、押运日志及发运照片，核验后才授权放行。
modules.hint: 先听一遍，再逐句跟读五遍。每轮用 25–35 秒，最后脱稿复述。

modules.title: 商务寒暄
lines: How was the road from the mine site?
从矿区过来的路况怎么样？
Mostly clear, but we had a short delay at the checkpoint.
基本畅通，但在检查点耽误了一会儿。
Thanks for the update.
谢谢你告知最新情况。
Is everyone safe?
大家都安全吗？
Yes, the team is safe and the truck is parked securely.
是的，人员安全，车辆也已妥善停放。
modules.hint: 先练习简短询问路况，再确认人员与车辆安全。

modules.title: 矿业业务场景
lines: We cannot authorize payment based on an unverified seal record.
封签记录尚未核实，我们无法授权付款。
Please provide the original dispatch documents and a signed discrepancy explanation.
请提供原始发运文件及签字确认的差异说明。
Both parties should photograph the seal and compare the original weighbridge and sample records.
双方应拍摄封签，并核对原始地磅单和取样封样记录。
If necessary, contact the traceability team and resume payment only after written clearance.
如有必要，请联系溯源团队，并在获得书面确认后恢复付款流程。
modules.hint: 模拟场景为收货点验货、付款点结算。供应商要求先付款，押运员却发现封签号不符。练习先保障人员安全，再书面索取凭证。

modules.title: 运输与押运
lines: Keep the truck at the secure checkpoint.
请将车辆停在安全检查点。
Do not open the container or replace the seal.
不要开箱或更换封签。
Record the time, location, driver name, and both seal numbers.
记录时间、位置、司机姓名及两组封签号。
Send clear photos to logistics and compliance.
向物流与合规团队发送清晰照片。
Record the customs seal separately from the company seal.
请分别登记海关铅封和公司封签。
Compare the stuffing report with the photos taken on site.
把装柜报告与现场照片进行核对。
modules.hint: 向押运人员口述四条指令，再说明如何区分海关铅封和公司封签。

modules.title: 十五分钟角色扮演
lines: Play the procurement lead and respond to a supplier demanding immediate payment of thirty-six thousand five hundred and thirty-one dollars.
第 1–5 分钟扮演采购负责人，回应供应商立即支付 36,531 美元的要求。
I understand your request, but payment will remain on hold until we verify the seal record.
我理解你的要求，但在封签记录核验完成前，付款将继续暂停。
Play the logistics lead and ask the escort officer for the location, photos, weighbridge ticket, and stuffing report.
第 6–10 分钟扮演物流负责人，向押运员索取位置、照片、地磅单及装柜报告。
Please send your location first, then send the photos and the original weighbridge ticket.
请先发送你的位置，然后发送照片和原始地磅单。
Play the finance lead and explain the hold to the bank before the cut-off time.
第 11–15 分钟扮演财务负责人，在截止前向银行解释暂缓付款的原因。
We will provide the supporting documents or a revised timeline by three p.m. Kigali time.
我们将在基加利时间下午三点前提交支持文件或更新处理时间。
modules.hint: 每轮 5 分钟，至少说 5 句完整英文。用最后一句总结风险和下一步。

modules.title: 听写五句
lines: The seal number does not match our dispatch record.
封签号与我们的发运记录不符。
Please keep the truck at the checkpoint.
请让车辆停在检查点。
We need the original weighbridge ticket.
我们需要原始地磅单。
The payment will remain on hold.
付款将继续暂停。
Please send the signed report before three p.m.
请在下午三点前发送签字报告。
modules.hint: 先点读再默写。点击「查看句子」核对中英文本，重点检查 seal、dispatch、weighbridge、remain 和 signed。

modules.title: 口语测试五题
lines: What should you do when the seal number is inconsistent?
封签号不一致时，你应该怎么做？
How do you request evidence politely but firmly?
如何礼貌而坚定地索取证据？
How do you explain a bank payment hold?
如何解释银行暂停付款？
How do you state a deadline in Kigali time?
如何明确用基加利时间表述截止点？
How do you refuse premature release?
如何拒绝提前放行？
modules.hint: 每题用英文作答 30–45 秒。回答时给出行动、理由和下一步。

modules.title: 前三天变化复习
lines: Sampling dispute and independent assay.
Day 23：样品争议与第三方化验。
Packing list and customs seal.
Day 24：装箱单与海关铅封。
Beneficiary account change and payment verification.
Day 25：收款账户变更与付款核验。
First, we verify the sample.
首先，我们核验样品。
Next, we reconcile the export documents.
接下来，我们核对出口单证。
Finally, we verify the beneficiary before releasing payment.
最后，在付款前核验收款人。
modules.hint: 先分别回顾 Day 23、24、25，再用后三句串联取样、出口单证和付款核验。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
lines: Good afternoon.
下午好。
During today's escorted mineral transfer, our logistics team identified a discrepancy between the seal number on the container and the number recorded in the dispatch documents.
今天押运矿产品途中，物流团队发现集装箱封签号与发运文件记录不一致。
The truck is now parked at a secure checkpoint, and no one has been authorized to open the container.
车辆已停在安全检查点，目前未授权任何人开箱。
We have requested the original weighbridge ticket, dispatch photographs, escort log, and signed stuffing report.
我们已索取原始地磅单、发运照片、押运日志和签字装柜报告。
In parallel, our finance team has informed the bank that payment must remain on hold until the supporting documents are verified.
同时，财务团队已通知银行，在支持文件核验前继续暂停付款。
We understand the shipment deadline, but we cannot compromise traceability or compliance.
我们理解发运时限，但不能为此牺牲可追溯性或合规性。
Please send the complete evidence package by three p.m. Kigali time.
请于基加利时间下午三点前发送全套证据。
Once our logistics and compliance teams confirm the facts in writing, we will provide the next release and payment instructions.
物流和合规团队书面确认事实后，我们将提供下一步放行及付款指令。
Thank you for your cooperation.
谢谢配合。
modules.hint: 先分句练习，再完整朗读。复述时交代差异、车辆状态、证据清单、付款状态、截止时间和书面放行。

modules.title: 完成清单
lines: Spend eight minutes on pronunciation and twelve minutes on the key terms and sentences.
发音热身 8 分钟，词汇与核心句 12 分钟。
Spend eight minutes on numbers and eight on shadowing.
数字训练与逐句跟读各 8 分钟。
Spend four minutes on small talk and eight on operations and transport.
商务寒暄 4 分钟，业务与运输 8 分钟。
Spend fifteen minutes on role-play and eight on dictation and speaking.
角色扮演 15 分钟，听写及口语测试 8 分钟。
Spend four minutes reviewing and delivering the full briefing.
复习与完整陈述 4 分钟。
modules.hint: 逐项检查，合计约 75 分钟。课程采用虚构情景与教学数据。
